titolo: Anthropic files for IPO, targeting ticker “ANT”
descr: Anthropic submitted an S‑1 on October 26, 2026, officially beginning the process for an initial public offering.
paragrafi: Anthropic submitted an S‑1 on October 26, 2026, officially beginning the process for an initial public offering.
The filing shows first‑half 2026 revenue of $16.3 billion, up from $1.2 billion a year earlier, while operating loss narrowed to $693 million from $2.1 billion in the same period of 2025.
Net loss was $80.7 billion, driven mainly by non‑cash adjustments tied to convertible debt, and the company warned it may not achieve profitability.
The governance plan gives the seven co‑founders a “Founder LLC” that controls 50.1% of voting power, while a Long‑Term Benefit Trust will appoint most board members.
perche: The IPO could increase Anthropic’s access to capital, influencing the broader AI market and competition for both paid and free models. Users of free or locally hosted models may see heightened focus on safety and governance as Anthropic’s founder‑controlled structure aims to preserve its public‑benefit mission.
